title: Give the Computer Exact Instructions
style: calm luminous storybook watercolor with clear cutaway mechanisms

pages.text: Computers follow instructions in programs. In our game, you can give clear steps to reach a goal.
Ask a friend to draw a house. Give every little step and see what they draw.
Good instructions go one step at a time. First this, then that.
The order matters. You put your socks on before your shoes.
Exact instructions work best. 'Three steps forward' is better than 'walk a long way.'

quickWords.th: คำสั่งที่ชัดเจน
ไปข้างหน้า

pages.text: On the grid, Vanilla starts at A1 facing up. Move forward 3 squares, turn right, then move forward 4 squares to her treat at E4.

quickWords.th: ตารางช่องสี่เหลี่ยม

pages.text: Vanilla reached the slipper instead of the treat! Check the steps, find what went wrong, and try again.

quickWords.th: รองเท้าแตะ

pages.text: Change that one step and try again. Fixing instructions is how programmers work.

quickWords.th: โปรแกรมเมอร์

pages.text: You can give exact instructions anywhere. Can you say the steps from your door to your bed?

quickWords.th: ตรงตามคำสั่ง
